_comment: GHCR mirror manifest — the single source of truth for every EXTERNAL image the web10 build/run stack pulls. We republish each to ghcr.io/jacoby149/ so CI (e2e, docker, cd) and the deploy never touch Docker Hub (or any third-party registry) at runtime: Docker Hub's anonymous pull rate limit (100/6h per shared runner IP) was flaking the e2e shards (minio/minio 'pull access denied'), and a third-party GHCR (astral-sh/uv) is the same class of dependency. The ghcr-mirror.yml workflow reads this file and `docker buildx imagetools create`s each source -> target (manifest copy, no build). To bump an image: change its `source` here, re-run the mirror workflow, done. Target tags are STABLE (pinned) — CI pulls them by tag, so an upstream `:latest` move never silently changes what we run. All images are mirrored for linux/amd64 only (every consumer — ubuntu-latest runners, the box — is amd64).

images._note: sourced from Quay, not Docker Hub — minio/minio is the most-pulled image on Docker Hub and its anonymous rate-limit bucket (100/6h per shared runner IP) is chronically exhausted, which is what flaked the e2e shards. Quay has no such shared-IP limit.
